source: HW handoff 2026-09-18 s22_camera_estimate_v005.json lenses.ultrawide.T_lens_tcp, cross-checked against the 2026-09-11 5149-frame marker-midpoint measurement
child_axes: +X jaw opening, +Y up, +Z horizontal approach toward the upright object

axis_mapping_derivation.old_saved_jpeg_to_upright_v1: Rz(180deg); the new collector bakes the 180-degree pixel rotation
axis_mapping_derivation.old_saved_jpeg_from_cad_lens: Rz(+90deg), solved by requiring the CAD gripper_tcp axes to equal the video-checked v10 canonical axes

video_marker_midpoint_crosscheck.interpretation: Axes agree after the explicit image-frame conversion. The non-zero translation is expected because the video point is the marker midpoint while the CAD point is the nominal design TCP; it also contains unmeasured CAD-lens-to-optical-origin error.

limitations: The CAD gripper_tcp is used as the nominal v10 pad-centre design TCP, but its coincidence with the physical contact-pad centre has not been measured.
The CAD lens origin is not an independently measured optical entrance pupil.
The 14.75 mm lateral disagreement with the earlier HW fingertip-origin estimate remains unresolved.
Use for dataset regeneration and Track A/B contract comparison only; do not use to command real motors.
